name: editor
description: Integer, orthogonal, path-only SVG editing library for synoptic-view symbols.

scripts.docs:dev: cargo run --release -q -p api-pages -- src/index.ts docs/api /api/ editor && vitepress dev docs
scripts.fix: cargo run --release -q -p format -- --write "*" .cargo .agents .claude/settings.json .githooks .github docs playground scripts src tests tools && oxlint --fix --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives-severity=error *.ts docs playground scripts src tests && cargo run --release -q -p lint -- --fix *.ts *.md .agents .github docs playground scripts src tests && { [ -z "$(git status --porcelain -- '*.rs' '*Cargo.toml' Cargo.lock)" ] || cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked --quiet --fix --allow-dirty --allow-staged; } && cargo fmt --all
scripts.check:all: cargo run --release -q -p heavy-lock -- cargo run --release -q -p repo-tools --bin check-all
